mode: Next.js production local server, warm server/image optimizer, cold independent browser contexts, CDP cache disabled

interaction.note: Includes Playwright transport and actionability overhead, not field INP.

limitations: Laboratory observations on this Mac, not a mobile handset or field metric.
CDP simulates bandwidth/latency and CPU but not mobile GPU behavior.
A local origin and warm image optimizer do not represent geographic CDN latency.
Other existing workspace applications were not stopped; this is not an isolated benchmark host.
Initial resource totals can include Next.js link prefetch; scripts and complete request lists are retained.
